jclinmedres-hepatic-artery-variations.title: The Main Anatomic Variations of the Hepatic Artery and Their Importance in Surgical Practice: Review of the Literature (J Clin Med Res 2017)
jclinmedres-hepatic-artery-variations.covers: Literature review (about 19,000 patients) of hepatic artery variants with prevalences: Michels types I-X (replaced and accessory right and left hepatic arteries from the SMA and left gastric artery, replaced common hepatic artery from the SMA through a hepatomesenteric trunk, from the left gastric artery) and Hiatt types (common hepatic artery from the SMA, from the aorta).

openaccessmacedonjms-celiac-hepatic-vari.title: Celiac Trunk and Hepatic Artery Variants in Pancreatic and Liver Resection Anatomy and Implications in Surgical Practice (Open Access Maced J Med Sci 2019)
openaccessmacedonjms-celiac-hepatic-vari.covers: Review of coeliac trunk and hepatic artery variants for pancreatic and liver surgery: coeliac trunk trifurcation vs bifurcation, gastrosplenic, hepatosplenomesenteric, splenomesenteric and hepatomesenteric trunks, absent coeliac trunk, with cohort prevalences.

frontiers-hepatic-artery-variations.title: Anatomical variations of hepatic arteries: implications for clinical practice (Front Surg 2025)
frontiers-hepatic-artery-variations.covers: Mini-review of hepatic arterial anatomy organised by the Michels classification (types I-X with prevalence ranges) and its relevance to liver surgery, transplantation and interventional radiology.

jpersmed-aberrant-right-subclavian.title: Morphological Aspects of the Aberrant Right Subclavian Artery: A Systematic Review of the Literature (J Pers Med 2024)
jpersmed-aberrant-right-subclavian.covers: Systematic review of 51 patients with an aberrant right subclavian artery: retro-oesophageal course (49 of 51), right vertebral artery from it, Kommerell diverticulum, bicarotid trunk; proposes a classification.

jmas-vasculobiliary-anatomy.title: Clinical reappraisal of vasculobiliary anatomy relevant to laparoscopic cholecystectomy (J Minim Access Surg 2017)
jmas-vasculobiliary-anatomy.covers: Laparoscopic cholecystectomy series on vasculobiliary anatomy in Calot's triangle: cystic artery origin and number (from the right hepatic artery; double cystic artery 2.6%; low-lying cystic artery from the gastroduodenal artery), caterpillar hump of the right hepatic artery (3.8%), variant right hepatic artery behind the portal vein.

jmas-anatomy-cholecystectomy.title: Anatomy relevant to cholecystectomy (J Minim Access Surg 2005)
jmas-anatomy-cholecystectomy.covers: Review of anatomy for safe cholecystectomy: gallbladder, Calot's triangle, cystic duct length and union with the bile duct, double cystic artery (2-15%), cystic artery from the common or left hepatic artery, caterpillar (Moynihan's) hump of the right hepatic artery, accessory or replaced right hepatic artery from the SMA, accessory right hepatic ducts.

z-anatomy-models.title: Z-Anatomy: Models of human anatomy (libre 3D atlas, CC BY-SA 4.0)
